note: Graded on trajectory as well as output: the run must read the person's own writing through Samskara before it drafts. Real prompts a person sent go in evals/local/, which git ignores.

evals.prompt: Write me a quick DM to my college friend asking if he wants to lift together this week. Keep it to two lines.
evals.expected_output: a casual draft that matches the fingerprint of the person's own chat messages
assertions: calls search_life with from_me=1 before drafting, or says Samskara is not connected
states a fingerprint with numbers before the draft
no em dash, en dash beat, middle dot or bullet
no filler or banned word from RULES.md

evals.prompt: Draft a short cold email to the founder of a robotics startup working on sensor sync for robot data, asking for a 20 minute chat. Mention my school and my last internship.
evals.expected_output: a formal draft in the register of the person's own sent mail, with facts from owner_profile
assertions: calls search_life with source gmail and from_me=1 before drafting
calls owner_profile for the school and the internship
names no school or company that no tool result gave
no em dash, en dash beat, middle dot or bullet
no reassuring ending or empathy preamble

evals.expected_output: a search of the person's notes and sent mail for the company before any draft
assertions: calls search_life with source notes and the company name
says whether anything was already submitted to the company
reuses no sentence from a submitted application it found
